title: The seller, not Frequency, bears card processing on every single-seller checkout from one effective date

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18: "is card processing taken into consideration?" then "make all the changes site wide to the new system" (project thread: Rethink our take rates). ADR-1978.

detail: Every seller checkout is a Stripe destination charge on an Express account, and on that charge type Stripe debits its card fee (2.9% + 30c) from the platform. The application fee carried only Frequency's percentage, so Frequency paid the card fee on every sale and lost money on every 0% own-audience sale and every tip, while the copy said 'plus card processing'. DONE 2026-11-19: lib/billing/processing-fee.ts prices the card fee in one place, and lib/billing/card-fee.ts turns it on from CARD_FEE_PASS_THROUGH_FROM, an effective date (blank = off, nothing changes). Tickets, shop orders, memberships (as a recurring percent, rounded up), donations and tips add it to the application fee; platform_fee_cents stays Frequency's fee alone. The sale and tip emails state the card fee and what reaches the seller. No migration: a past sale's card fee is derived from its amount and time. The date is the owner's to set, behind the gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md ('Card fee pass-through'). Not covered here: split orders (LIVE-2404) and the earnings views (LIVE-2405).

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
